# Lane 2.202, part 2: a real PostgreSQL on this computer, for tests

## Fix round (2026-11-22T07:41Z, 5fd205b, 20bde6b, c453a25, merged at 238d315)

- **H1 done (5fd205b).** `checkLoginRole` follows every membership of the login to any depth (PostgreSQL 16's SET and ADMIN options read; older servers: any membership counts). Real-server plants by the tables' owner, each taken away again: the reviewer's `p_byp` (bypassrls, holds app*user) granted to app_login, and a deeper one through `p_mid`. The reviewer's plant now prints: "app_login may become p_byp*…, which bypasses row-level security: revoke p*byp*… from app_login".
- **M1 done (5fd205b).** Owned tables are looked for in every schema but `pg_*` and `information_schema`. Real-server plant: a role owning `platform.p_own_…_kept`, inherited by app*login with set false ("app_login may act as p_own*…, which owns a table (platform.p*own*…_kept): revoke p_own_… from app_login"). PGlite also covers `sign_in` and a new schema.
- **L1 done (5fd205b).** Each of superuser, bypassrls, createrole, createdb, replication gets its own sentence, as "app_login may create roles: alter role app_login nocreaterole" (real-server plant: `alter role app_login createrole`). Other sentences: "X owns tables (…), so it could switch their fence off: reassign owned by X to <database owner>" (or, for the owner itself, "the app must log in as a role of its own (as app_login is), not as the tables' owner"); "X is not app_user and cannot become it: grant app_user to X"; "X is a member of app_user but may not switch to it (set role): grant app_user to X with set true". A role reached with ADMIN only counts as one the login may become (it could grant itself SET).
- **L2 done (20bde6b).** `start` notes the folders' old modes in `<folder>/modes-on-the-way.json`; `stop`, a failed start and the next start put them back. Real-server test: a second server under a 0700 folder, 0711 while it runs, 0700 after stop.
- **L3 done (20bde6b).** `stop` and a fresh `start` remove only an empty folder or one holding `connection.json`, `modes-on-the-way.json` or `data/PG_VERSION`; else "FAILED: nothing was removed, because <folder> is not a folder this command made (…)". Tested in `tests/real-postgres-rules.test.mjs`.
- **L4 and the record done (c453a25).** H1, M1 and L1 share one query, so they are one commit, not three; L2 and L3 share one script, so one commit.
- **Nothing the product needs is refused:** app_login (app_user and sign_in_store, as prepared by `prepare-real-postgres.ts` and the test copy) passes on the real server and on PGlite; neither role owns a table or holds a power (migrations 0005 and 0012 make them so); `made-up-database.test.ts`, `startup.test.ts` and `start-worker.test.ts` pass.
- **Run:** `npm run check`, `format:check`, the type check (again after the merge), `test:real-postgres` (29 passed, 5 files), `packages/database/src/db`, probe-logins, remove-league, made-up-database, isolation-coverage, the web start-up and worker start tests, the rules test (13). **Not run:** the whole suite, `npm run verify`, the browser tests; the older-server path only on PGlite with the options switched off.

**Where it stood.** Four commits by the first builder (35e21cd checkLoginRole, 8291ceb the script, b40ef61 the tests, 8bf1626 record 092, T-292, `docs/operations/real-postgres.md`), never seen to run: on a machine where the session is root, `npm run test:real-postgres` failed at "make its database files".

**What I built.**

- Merge of `origin/build/stage-1` (845652d): no conflict; the type check passes after it.
- 2756c52: `start` makes the folders inside `.local` on the way to `.local/pg` passable (not readable) for the server's own `postgres` account; mkdir had made `.local` for root alone, so initdb could not read its password file. New rule `foldersOnTheWay` in `scripts/real-postgres-rules.mjs`, its test in `tests/real-postgres-rules.test.mjs` (11 tests pass). Proof: `npm run test:real-postgres` passes here, 5 files, 24 tests, PostgreSQL 16.15.
